_doc: FULLSTACK-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25: 'All UltraStable systems shall automatically deploy themselves: repo, back-end, and public-facing Web UI front-end. Ultrastable is a full-stack autonomous development platform/system.'). Every system Ultrastable runs has three parts: its own repository, a live back end and a public web front end. Systems come from instances/ultrastable/progress.json (repo and url are read from there) and doctrine/seed-deploys.json; this file adds each system's back-end address and, for a system that lacks a part, the queue item that is building it. foundation/fullstack.py --check fails a system with a part that is neither declared nor on an open item; --live fetches the front end and the back end and fails when one does not answer; a row with public_repo is also fetched at github.com, so a repository that was declared and never made reads missing. A seed's repository is made from the seed template by deploy/tenant-repo.mjs --seeds. Visitor apps are judged by deploy/launch-apps.mjs (stackOf) on every launch run.
